t: Grades 3 to 5 lessons that use micro:bits and sensors in school gardens.
steps: Find the Garden TOOLS site from the University of Nebraska-Lincoln.
Download the Garden TOOLS for Corn lesson set.
Download the how-to coding guides and the finished code.
Obtain BBC micro:bits with battery packs and environmental sensors.
Open MakeCode in a browser and test the finished code on one micro:bit.
Watch the video tutorials and project cards.
Try the professional development modules before the first lesson.
